webScreens.name: Nomination Cuts (Scheduler persona widget)
webScreens.notes: READ FULLY. [QSecurityObject("QVpNominationCuts")], extends QPTMInterfaceControllerBase directly. Registers two grids: [QControllerRootBind] QDOListContainer<ConfirmationSummaryDO> NomCutsListCurrentGasDay + NomCutsListNextGasDay; KPI NomCutsCount; cycle-label state (Cycles/CycleTypes/IdCycleCurrentGasDay/IdCycleNextGasDay from NAESB cycle type codes). DoQuery finds last CLOSED nomination cycle before the open cycle per gas day (IQPTMCycleWidget.GetCycleInfo, DeadlineCategory.Nomination) then IQPTMNominationWidget.GetConfirmationsCuts(tsp, today, tomorrow), split by gas day. DoSave/DoValidate/DoClone empty (read-only); DoReadStream re-runs DoQuery (live re-query on restore). Params QUICNomCutsParams registers GasDay (RequiredForQuery|AutoPush).

classicScreens.name: Confirmation Response Filter
classicScreens.notes: Registered in RegisterScreensCF.cpp via QREGISTERSCREENSAPI(QVpConfirmationResponseFilterDlg, ID_CONFIRMATIONRESPONSEFILTERDLG, "PipelineMgrCF.dll"). Security name 'Confirmation Response Filter', ID QVpConfirmationResponseFilterDlg. QTDialog derived from QTVFilterDlg (IDD_DLG_CONFIRMATIONRESPONSEFILTER) — tree-view filter popup for the Confirmation Response screen. Filter fields: location (pactrl_loc.loc_id), location group (pactrl_loc_grp), analyst contact (pactrl_loc_contact/kctrl_contact), confirming party (kctrl_bp_entity_hdr via primary_bp_no), exclude-CBE indicator (pactrl_loc_attr), gas day (cfctrl_conf). Uses filter data class QTVFilterDataConfirmationResponse (same folder, non-screen helper). OnOK resolves location group hierarchy via QPipelineMgrUtility::ResolveLocGroupHierarchy.

classicScreens.name: Life Cycle
classicScreens.notes: Registered in RegisterScreensCF.cpp via QREGISTERSCREENSAPI(QVpLifeCycle, ID_LIFECYCLE, "PipelineMgrCF.dll"). Security name 'Life Cycle', ID QVpLifeCycle. Classic MFC QTFormView multi-row query grid (IDD_LIFECYCLE), read-only nomination lifecycle trace on table nnctrl_lifecycle joined to nnctrl_nom_hdr/nnctrl_nom_dtl. Gas-day range filter required (error CFLIFEE001); external users limited to 1-month range (CFLIFEE003, Issue 31023) and must supply rec_loc/del_loc/sr_bp/sr_ctr (CFLIFEE002, Issue 6502). Context data: gas_day(+from/to), cycle_id, rec/del loc, sr/rec/del bp+ctr, pkg_id, rec/del_pkg_id, nom_id. Lease-nom source columns shown for internal users when NOMINATIONS/LEASE_NOM_DISTINCT_PATHS=true (Issue 85065); route_cd column visibility driven by TSP config CONTRACTUAL_PATHS_START_DT. No tabs.
